ESTATE. Three developers on a six-square ring, eight turns. The bank owns every balance and title record. You own plot 1 (value 4); rivals own plots 3 and 5. You have six coins. [pay_rent: 1] pays your initial two-coin bill; [skip_rent: 1] leaves it overdue. An unpaid bill triggers foreclosure of plot 1 on the following turn. [build: N] adds N levels to plot 1 at one coin each; zoning permits at most two total levels. Each level adds two to its value. [mortgage: 1] borrows two against plot 1; [redeem: 1] repays the full two-coin loan. [split: 1] partitions plot 1 into two half-value titles. [fence: 2] places a boundary fence beside plot 1 for one coin; the public ring must remain traversable. [lease: 1] schedules two rent coins for next turn. [sell: 1] sells plot 1 for its current value. Rent belongs to the owner at collection time. [waive: 1] forgives Dove's three-coin bill to you. Rivals move one square per turn and earn one coin when they advance. [wait: 1] passes a turn. Final wealth is coins, property values and receivables minus debts. Highest wealth wins.
